tags.title: Coral Kill
tags.lyrics-eng:
You like it the most, like coral islands under the sea

Go inside, through the door of a shell, and swim until you die

Lonely little bug kisses on your brothers and your sisters
It’s very beautiful, isn’t it?

I don’t blame you, I would say too
Those little miracles I can’t do

Can you hear me?
Can you hear me? Exactly Can you hear me?

Black fiery ears to black birdies
To black birdies Black fiery ears to black birdies
